method: Steam launch with an approved temporary clearing checkpoint; actual ChangeForm window; pointer positioning through a one-unit wheel event without clicking form buttons; visual inspection of all four complete descriptions and renderer log; Glabro rechecked after switching.
limitations: The first pointer-drag attempt confirmed Glabro in the temporary test session. The checkpoint was reloaded before the four-description inspection; no transformation was confirmed during that inspection.
Homid is the current form and its button is disabled; its description was evaluated through Ink and its tutorial paragraph was visible, not selected in this window.
Only the observed Windows/Steam configuration was tested, not all resolutions or complete gameplay branches.
